Specification: This module is a thin wrapper around an existing hour-clock specification, providing Apalache type annotations while keeping the original specification separate. The comments explain that it applies annotations to HourClock2.tla via INSTANCE, and that HourClock2 is an alternative formulation of HourClock using `(hr % 12) + 1` instead of an `IF`-`THEN`-`ELSE`. The file itself declares the clock variable `hr`, extends Naturals, and instantiates the module `HourClock2`, but it contains no top-level behavioral operators, actions, or temporal properties of its own.
